experiment: V2 real anomaly replay: Static vs FR(R-only) vs JD(R→π), persistent J2 anomaly

design.shared_condition: V2 FR J1 (8,609 chars, 25 parties) + injected persistent J2 anomaly (R also returns empty)
design.anomaly_source: Real V2 FR J2 empty output (DS natural anomaly, verified)

arms.Fixed-Recovery: detect → R(DS retry) → still empty → give up
arms.Joint-Dynamic: detect → R(DS retry) → still empty → π(switch to Qwen) → recovered

pi_fallback_comparison.lesson: GLM unsuitable for structured verification fallback (thinking-token issue); Qwen 0% truncation rate confirmed

scientific_conclusion.primary: When same-model retry cannot resolve a persistent anomaly, switching to a heterogeneous model with different failure modes is the only effective recovery
scientific_conclusion.evidence_level: single controlled anomaly replay (not natural execution statistics)
limitations: one fallback tested successfully (Qwen); GLM failed
Q=0.350 is recovery quality, not full pipeline quality ceiling
